verdict.rationale: Sprinto's docs describe a SOC 2 Launchpad that generates a blueprint and drives policies, risks, and evidence. They also cite pre-mapped controls, continuous evidence collection with AI gap analysis, audit-partner selection, and in-platform auditor collaboration, which covers the core of running a SOC 2 program end to end. missing for 10: explicit documentation of Type I vs Type II audit support, explicit mapping to the Trust Services Criteria, detail on the built-in policy templates, independent or hands-on corroboration.
